entry.title: SMILESGNN: Interpretable Clinical Toxicity Prediction via SMILES-Graph Cross-Attention Fusion
entry.summary: arXiv:2609.28553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Drug toxicity prediction is critical for reducing late-stage attrition in drug discovery, yet remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, scaffold-based generalization, and the clinical need for interpretable predictions.
entry.arxiv:journal_reference: 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR)
entry.dc:creator: Quang Minh Nguyen, Thuy Quynh Nguyen, Duc Minh Le, Ho Nhat Minh Nguyen, Thanh Long Dai Doan, Trong Nghia Nguyen

entry.title: Reconstructing short-lived particles using hypergraph representation learning
entry.summary: arXiv:2402.10149v3 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In collider experiments, the kinematic reconstruction of heavy, short-lived particles is vital for precision tests of the Standard Model and in searches for physics beyond it.
entry.dc:creator: Callum Birch-Sykes, Brian Le, Yvonne Peters, Ethan Simpson, Zihan Zhang

entry.title: DCRMTA: Deep Causal Representation Learning for Multi-Touch Attribution
entry.summary: arXiv:2401.08875v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-touch attribution (MTA) is essential for estimating the contribution of individual advertising touchpoints to user conversions.
entry.dc:creator: Jiaming Tang, Jingxuan Wen, Liping Jing
